I can't give you an amount for beta-alanine. Dosing supplements is one for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can set it based on your health and what else you take.

For general context, it's a supplement people use for high-rep and short-interval work, and the tingling feeling some notice is a known effect. It does far less for your training than sleep, eating enough protein, and consistent progressive overload.

If you want, tell me what you're training for and I'll look at how your sessions are set up.
